extracted.intended_audience: journalists and media professionals covering transgender issues; reporters and editors seeking style and research resources
extracted.subtask_description: A short resource page for journalists and media requesting interviews or guidance about covering transgender issues and the Trans Student Educational Resources (TSER) project. It lists recommended style guides and research resources and provides a media contact for interview requests or questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Contact / Interview Requests
rubrics_metrics.description: For interview requests from TSER staff or other media inquiries, please contact us at tser [at] transstudent.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this contact for interview requests or media questions about TSER; if you are a journalist writing about TSER in any capacity or have questions about how to write about these topics, feel free to email tser@transstudent.org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult reputable style and research guides
rubrics_metrics.description: Below are a few style and research guides from reputable sources and research guides we believe are useful for journalists covering transgender issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists should consult these external guides when reporting on transgender people and issues; the page presents these resources as recommended starting points rather than exhaustive instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: GLAAD Media Reference Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: GLAAD’s Media Reference Guide, now in its 11th edition, offers education and guidance on telling LGBTQ people’s stories in ways that bring out the best in journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use GLAAD's guide for language, framing, and ethical considerations when reporting on LGBTQ and transgender subjects; consult it for best-practice recommendations on portrayal and terminology.

rubrics_metrics.name: AP Transgender Coverage Topical Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: Associated Press guide to covering transgender topics. An overview of some key topics in understanding transgender people and how to cover them, followed by a granular list of terminology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the AP guide for practical, newsroom-oriented guidance including recommended terminology and topic overviews appropriate for wire/reporting contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trans Journalists Association Styleguide
rubrics_metrics.description: The Trans Journalists Association’s Stylebook and Coverage Guide is a tool reporters, editors, and other journalists can use to improve news coverage of trans people and the stories that affect them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to this stylebook for community-informed style recommendations and coverage considerations from trans journalists and advocates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cornell University Library — Transgender Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: This guide provides information and resources around research into trans rights, including tracking the status of current legislation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use academic and library research guides like Cornell's to find authoritative sources, legal tracking, and background research on trans rights and legislation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assigned Media: Trans Data Library
rubrics_metrics.description: The Trans Data Library, run by trans journalists, collects information about anti-trans political efforts in real time, to help people understand who is shaping the conversation on trans issues and why.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult this real-time data collection to identify actors, campaigns, and trends in anti-trans political activity relevant to reporting and investigative work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health Liberation Now! (trans-run resource)
rubrics_metrics.description: Health Liberation Now! is a free, trans-run resource analyzing the social and political forces opposing health liberation for transgender, detransitioned, retransitioned, gender diverse people, and gender questioning people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this resource for analyses and perspectives on health-related political forces impacting trans communities; useful for contextual reporting on health policy and debates.
